title: Afferent daily record v1 (Dimension 1, everyday, passive)
description: One record per patient per day. The record for date D covers the night ending on the morning of D plus the daytime of D. Built by the hub from bedside events and phone presence (or by the synthetic generator). null means not measured.

simulated.description: true if any field is simulated. The UI must label it SIMULATED.

simulated_fields.description: Dotted field names that are simulated even when real hardware is connected, e.g. ["steps"]

day_complete.description: false for today (still in progress); missed is only decided for complete days

sleep.description: From the infrared presence sensor at the bed

sleep_onset_h.description: Hours relative to midnight starting date D: -0.5 = 23:30 the evening before, 0.75 = 00:45

wake_time_h.description: Hours after midnight on date D, e.g. 7.25 = 07:15

restlessness_events.description: Presence-sensor motion bursts between sleep onset and wake

presence_hourly.description: Fraction of each local hour 0..23 of date D spent in bed. Input for inter-daily stability (IS) over 7 days.

morning_pulse_bpm.description: Optional 30 s KY-039 reading after waking (finger on the stone before 11:00)

presence.description: Phone presence via Wi-Fi/BLE at the bedside unit. Visitors are a count of unfamiliar nearby devices, nobody is identified.

steps.description: Phone accelerometer step-like activity. Simulated unless the app streams it (then remove from simulated_fields).

played.description: At least one session with status completed, partial or fell_asleep

declined.description: 'Not tonight' pressed, or sharing nothing_tonight/paused. Never counts as missed.

missed.description: day_complete and not played and not declined

session_time_h.description: Local hour of the first session that day

reminder_h.description: Local hour of the daily reminder
